title_en: Apparatus and method for transmitting and receiving a character message in the handy terminal
title_ko: 휴대용 단말기를 이용한 문자메시지 송수신하는 방법 및장치
abstract_en: An apparatus and a method for transmitting and receiving a text message by using a portable terminal are provided to enable a transmitter to set importance of the text message and transmit the text message, and output message reception notification in case of an emergency text message until a receiver checks the received text message. In a method for transmitting and receiving a text message, a first portable terminal sets importance information of a message when making a text message and transmits the made text message to a second portable terminal. The second portable terminal receives the text message and generates reception notification according to the importance information of the received text message until a user checks the reception(S304,S305).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 휴대용 단말기에서 문자메시지를 송수신하는 방법 및 장치 에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 방법은 제 1 휴대용 단말기에서 문자메시지 작성 시 메시지의 중요도 정보를 설정한 후 제 2 휴대용 단말기로 문자메시지를 전송하는 메시지 전송단계 및 제 2 휴대용 단말기에서는 상기 문자메시지를 수신하고, 상기 수신한 문자메시지의 중요도 정보에 따라 수신 확인 시까지 수신알림을 발생하는 메시지 수신 및 수신알림발생 단계를 포함한다.  
     따라서 본 발명은 휴대용 단말기에서 문자메시지 수신자가 수신한 문자메시지를 확인할 때까지 메시지 수신알림을 출력할 수 있는 방법 및 장치를 제공한다.  
       
       
     문자메시지, SMS, 수신확인, 수신알림, 긴급확인

title_en: System for registering safety in disaster
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve such a problem that although, in a system for registering safety in disaster, the system comprising both functions to register safety information of individual and to check safety information of family for public, and functions to create lists and statistics of safety information for each place or each family, for a local government requirement, in the past, only ones being specialized in the former or ones for creating a list of checked persons were available.  <P>SOLUTION: This system comprises: a function, for public, to identify a resident by a resident identification card from a resident card delivery machine, to register as safety check information with correlating with the family information, and to display information corresponding to the residents' family information only; and a function, for the local government, to reflect the safety information registered by the resident into a disaster prevention information database, and to output the number of evacuees at evacuation shelters and the number of safety-checked families in regions.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Multiple dwelling house management system coping with emergency earthquake flash
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a multiple dwelling house management system coping with an emergency earthquake flash, allowing residents in the place of outing destination to instantaneously confirm the occurrence of an earthquake in his residence when an earthquake occurs in a district where his multiple dwelling house is located, and then instantaneously confirm the safety of residents in each dwelling house.  <P>SOLUTION: A warning monitoring panel 10 includes an earthquake warning command signal transmitting means 10B for transmitting an earthquake warning command signal to a dwelling house information terminal 20 of each dwelling house on receiving an earthquake detection signal based on the emergency earthquake flash transmitted through a communication network N. The panel 10 is connected to a network communication means 30 for transmitting safety confirmation reporting information to a previously registered reporting address on receiving a safety confirmation signal from the multiple dwelling house information terminal 20, and the dwelling house information terminal 20 includes a safety confirmation signal transmitting means 20b having a safety confirmation signal transmitting switch 28 for returning a safety confirming signal to the warning monitoring panel 10.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Device and method for predicting evacuation status in disaster
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide information for predicting, over a wide range, evacuation of individual resident from each residence and for effectively advancing road maintenance preparing for setting and installation of a shelter and evacuation in disaster.  <P>SOLUTION: A device for predicting the state of evacuation of a large number of people evacuating to a plurality of shelters through a plurality of roads in disaster comprises: a data input unit 11 for inputting information of position of roads and shelters, evacuation routes, traveling speed in evacuation, population distribution in normal time, and evacuation start time; an internal storage device 20 for storing the information input into the data input unit 11; a prediction unit 12 for predicting the evacuation state on the basis of the information input into the data input unit 11; an output-display unit 13 for displaying the evacuation state predicted by the prediction unit 12. The road information input into the data input unit 11 includes the information of a plurality of nodes and the information of a plurality of links linking the nodes with each other.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: System and method for indicating evacuation status
abstract_en: A device used in institutions such as, but not limited to, hospitals, nursing homes, and other patient-care facilities, and hotels motels, schools, dormitories and cruise ships which, when activated, provides a visual indication locally, or at or near the room to which it is attached, as to whether or not a particular room has been evacuated during an emergency evacuation situation.

<P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a safety monitoring system allowing monitoring of not only presence/absence of a factor directly danger to a worker but also whether it is a situation needing a stop of work or not, and allowing not only notification of the danger to the worker on site but also direct comprehension of a situation on the site from a remote place such as the head office or a branch, an orderer, a responsible person, or the like.  <P>SOLUTION: This safety monitoring system includes: a monitor for monitoring a situation of the spot including a construction site and a peripheral area directly related to the construction site; an alarm device for transmitting caution information including the work stop, an evacuation start or the like to required personnel including the worker; a server connected to the monitor, steadily analyzing a signal from the monitor, and transmitting the prescribed caution information to the corresponding alarm device when it is decided that the situation on the site is the prescribed caution situation by an analysis result thereof; and an interface device for performing of transmission/reception of signals between the monitor and the server.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

A new device used in institutions such as, but not limited to, hospitals, nursing homes, and other patient-care facilities, and hotels and cruise ships which, when activated, provides a visual indication locally, at or near the room to which it is attached, and remotely at a central control station and/or hand held device, as to whether or not a particular room has been evacuated during an emergency evacuation situation.

<P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster information communication device using vending machines placed everywhere in a region as a communication means for communicating an evacuation warning and emergency information and advising family's safety and user's own safety in an emergency such as disasters.  <P>SOLUTION: A vending machine 1 has a communication means 24 enabling wired or wireless bidirectional communication through a network with a regional information center 30 connected to the police department, the Fire Defense Agency, and the disaster countermeasures headquarters. The vending machine 1 further includes: a display means 3 for displaying information; an input means 10 for inputting information; a recording means 22 for recording and reproducing information; a disaster countermeasuring means for determining the type of disaster from a start-up signal distributed from the regional information center in response to an emergency signal from the Fire Defense Agency, and selectively broadcasting an emergency warning and evacuation information; and a safety confirmation means connecting to the network and confirming inhabitants' safety through bidirectional communication.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Device and method for outputting evacuation status
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an evacuation status output device which can output information that enables macroscopic understanding of the evacuation status of disaster victims in case of disaster, using information transmitted from a mobile carried by a user, and an evacuation status output method.  <P>SOLUTION: The evacuation status output device includes: a first population approximate value calculation part for calculating a population approximate value per sector based on the number of mobiles within each range obtained as range information for each sector and a predetermined calculation rule; a second population approximate value calculation part for calculating a population approximate value for each mesh region divided into sections based on a predetermined division rule, from the population approximate value per sector; and an evacuation ratio calculation part for calculating an evacuation ratio for each mesh region based on a population approximate value per predetermined region when a disaster occurs and a population approximate value in the predetermined region at a predetermined time; and an output part for outputting the evacuation ratio calculated by the evacuation ratio calculation part.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Evacuation information distributing device and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To specifically announce significance and necessity of evacuation to inhabitants having less sense of crisis.SOLUTION: In evacuation, by a positional information obtaining unit 12, positional information indicating a position of each of active evacuee terminals 21 is obtained through a communication network 40 from the active evacuee terminals 21 classified on a terminal DB 16 out of communication terminals. By an evacuation status information generating unit 14, evacuation status information indicating an evacuation status of active evacuees 20 is generated on the basis of the positional information. The generated evacuation status information is distributed to passive evacuee terminals 31, 32 classified on the terminal DB 16 out of the communication terminals.

PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide measures for saving precious lives and measures for quickly performing mutual safety confirmation, even if huge tsunami occurs hereafter.SOLUTION: When receiving tsunami information or a tsunami mail, an electronic apparatus with a built-in GPS calculates an altitude value of a current location of the electronic apparatus, when the altitude value is less than or equal to a predicted height of the tsunami, issues an evacuation alarm, retrieves a site that is closest to the current location and exceeds the predicted height of the tsunami, and guides an evacuation route to the site, and when issuing or stopping the evacuation alarm, notifies a predetermined destination of the situation by an electronic mail.

title_en: System for confirming evacuation headcount and escape time of emergency escape drill situation, and confirming method thereof
title_ko: 비상탈출훈련시 대피 인원수와 탈출시간 확인시스템 및 그 확인방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for identifying an evacuation headcount and escape time during an emergency escape drill, the system including: an emergency situation unit to receive an emergency situation occurrence signal when an emergency situation occurs for an emergency escape drill on a ship; a timer to start counting time after the emergency situation unit receives the emergency situation occurrence signal; an evacuation identification informing unit to receive a headcount of persons evacuated to an emergency escape device from the ship after the timer starts counting time; and a display to receive and display the headcount from the evacuation identification informing unit and to receive and display an elapsed time from the count starting time of the timer by receiving the elapsed time from the timer when receiving the headcount. According to the present invention, when performing the emergency escape drill to prepare for the emergency situation on the ship, the performance of the emergency escape drill can be improved by measuring the performance of the emergency escape drill through identifying the headcount of emergency escaped persons while counting the escape time to contribute to saving lives when an actual emergency occurs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상탈출훈련시 대피 인원수와 탈출시간 확인시스템에 관한 것으로, 선박에서 비상탈출훈련을 위한 비상상황이 발생하는 경우, 비상상황 발생신호를 입력받는 비상상황부; 비상상황부가 비상상황 발생신호를 입력받은 후의 시간을 카운팅하기 시작하는 타이머부; 타이머부가 시간을 카운팅하기 시작한 후, 선박으로부터 비상탈출수단으로 대피한 인원수를 입력받는 대피확인 알림장치; 및 대피확인 알림장치로부터 인원수를 수신하여 디스플레이하고, 인원수를 수신할 때 타이머가 카운팅을 시작한 이후의 경과시간을 타이머로부터 수신하여 디스플레이하는 디스플레이부;를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 선박에서 비상상황을 대비하여 비상탈출훈련을 하는 경우 비상탈출한 인원수를 확인함과 동시에 탈출시간을 카운팅하여 비상탈출훈련의 성능을 측정함으로써, 비상탈출훈련의 성능을 향상시킬 수 있으므로 선박에서 실제 비상상황이 발생할 경우 인명구조에 기여할 수 있다.

abstract_en:
The present invention provides an evacuation notification system with which it is possible for the number of evacuees accommodated in many facilities or devices for emergency evacuation to be easily notified, and with which an evacuation status can be accurately understood on the basis of said notification.
The evacuation notification system comprises: an evacuation notification terminal device (T) which is capable of automatically transmitting, at predetermined time intervals, evacuation notification information including an input number of evacuees, a measured evacuation location, and relevant identification information, and which is provided at an evacuation site such as a facility or device; and a reception terminal device of a disaster prevention center (C) which, on the basis of the number of evacuees, the evacuation location and the identification information contained in the evacuation notification information that have been sent from the evacuation notification terminal device and have been received, displays an evacuation site mark on a map displayed on a terminal screen and displays the number of evacuees associated with said mark, and which can also display a movement history.

title_en: Mobile terminal device, call-to-action system, call-to-action method, call-to-action program, and safety verification system
abstract_en: Provided are a mobile terminal device and a safety confirmation system that can collect and provide information for safety confirmation while urging evacuation. The device is provided with: a current location acquisition unit (32) that acquires a current location when disaster occurrence information (30) has been received; a route display control unit (33) that displays a route that leads from the acquired current location to a pre-registered evacuation site; a start display control unit (34) that displays a start entry screen for entering an input that evacuation has started; and an action start information transmission unit (35) that transmits, when evacuation start information indicating that evacuation has started is entered from the start entry screen by an operation of a user, the evacuation start information to a pre-registered destination.

PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To grasp an evacuation status appropriately and conduct an evacuation activity smoothly in a building equipped with a temporary evacuation area the weak in a disaster uses as a temporary shelter during a fire.SOLUTION: An evacuation support facility comprises a temporary evacuation area (3) used as a temporary shelter on a floor of a building during a fire which is partitioned by a fire-resistant wall to protect from fire and is provided at a predetermined section on the floor while connected to an evacuation route in a vertical direction of the building, an entry/exit identification part (27) installed at an entrance part of the temporary evacuation area for identifying and detecting an individual who passes through the entrance part, and a monitoring part for creating and displaying room-staying person information, which identifies an individual staying in a room, in the temporary evaluation area according to the detection results of the entry/exit identification part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide users with comprehensive evacuation guiding support by executing evacuation guiding support, safety confirmation support, or support for a rescue request according to need at appropriate timing in time series.SOLUTION: When evacuation guiding management means accepts the selection designation of a type of evacuation guiding object disaster, it determines a type of initial guidance on the basis of the type of evacuation guiding object disaster, attribute information on a user, positional information on the current location of the user, and information on whether the user can move by themselves accepted by self-moving related information reception means, notifies the user of it, and performs first automated processing for a rescue request site through communication means according to the type of initial guidance, or searches for the nearest evacuation shelter or safe place to guide the user to the nearest evacuation shelter or safe place by guiding means, and after the user moves to the nearest evacuation shelter or safe place, performs second automated processing for a safety confirmation site through the communication means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Safety confirmation system for elderly people
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide precise safety confirmation means that does not make elderly people conscious of being watched and does not force a watcher to bear personnel and cost burden.SOLUTION: In the home of an elderly people, a tablet terminal 1 operated daily as a living tool, a server 2 that collects, transmits, and accumulates its operation state, and a personal computer 3 that provides a watcher side with safety information are provided. The server 2 notifies the tablet terminal 1 in the home of an elderly people of a message, and disaster prevention and disaster-proof information. In a peacetime disaster prevention training, training is performed meticulously to read disaster prevention and disaster-proof information without delay and to stay indoors or move to an evacuation place according to the information. Through perfect training and by reading state confirmation means provided with a watcher side, elderly people who have read the information can be presumed to have avoided disaster.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a quick and certain safety confirmation work using entering/leaving information managed by an entering/leaving management system even when the entering/leaving management system stops functions due to power failure or the like at the occurrence of a disaster.SOLUTION: The entering/leaving management system generates and manages entering/leaving information by a center device 10 on the basis of user identification information of an IC card read by a card reader 18 for entering/leaving or the like. A plurality of safety confirmation terminals 24 are connected to the center device 10, and the entering/leaving information of the center device 10 is updated and recorded without delay at any time or in each predetermined cycle. When the safety confirmation terminal is disconnected from the center device 10 so as to be carried out at the occurrence of a disaster, the safety confirmation terminal 24 generates entering/leaving information by attaching information indicating an evaluation status of an in-building person to the entering/leaving information recorded at that time. Also, the safety confirmation terminal 24 collects the entering/leaving information from the other one or more safety confirmation terminals so as to be merged with its own entering/leaving information, and generates and displays the entering/leaving information including the information indicating the evacuation status of the in-building person.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: System and method for support decision making for damage caused by water disaster
title_ko: 수재해로 인한 피해 대응 의사결정 지원 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a decision making supporting system to cope with damage caused by a flood disaster includes: a flooding predicting unit which predicts flooding information including the region and water level of flooding caused by a flood disaster; an information transmitting unit which transmits the flooding information predicted in the flooding predicting unit to a portable terminal of an evacuee; a reception confirming unit which receives the current location information of the evacuee through the portable terminal of the evacuee while confirming whether the flooding information is received from the portable terminal of the evacuee, and receives mobile ability level information of an evacuee selected through the portable terminal of the evacuee; an evacuation route determining unit which, in the portable terminal of the evacuee, determines an evacuation route by using the flooding information, the current location information of the evacuee, and the mobile ability level information of the selected evacuee; an evacuation situation determining unit which determines an evacuation situation by identifying an estimated evacuation area and the estimated number of people to evacuate through the determined evacuation route and whether the flooding information is received from the portable terminal of the evacuee confirmed through the reception confirming unit; and a rescue decision making unit which determines the priority of rescue operations according to evacuees by using the identified number of estimated people to evacuate, the information on the estimated evacuation area, the flooding information, and the current location information and mobile ability level information of the evacuee. The present invention is provided for quick and safe evacuation and rescue.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 의한 수재해로 인한 피해 대응 의사결정 지원 시스템은 수재해로 인한 침수 지역 및 수위를 포함하는 침수 정보를 예측하는 침수예측부, 상기 침수예측부에서 예측된 상기 침수 정보를 대피자 휴대단말기로 전달하는 정보전달부, 상기 대피자 휴대단말기로부터 상기 침수 정보의 수신여부를 확인하는 한편, 상기 대피자 휴대단말기를 통해 대피자의 현재위치 정보를 제공받으며, 상기 대피자 휴대단말기를 통해 선택된 대피자 이동능력등급 정보를 수신하는 수신확인부, 상기 대피자 휴대단말기에서, 상기 대피자의 현재위치 정보, 상기 침수 정보를 이용하여 대피경로를 결정하되, 상기 선택된 대피자의 이동능력등급 정보를 이용하여 상기 대피경로를 결정하는 대피경로결정부, 상기 수신확인부를 통해 확인된 상기 대피자 휴대단말기의 침수 정보 수신여부와, 상기 결정된 대피경로를 통해 대피예상인원과 대피예상지역을 파악하여 대피상황을 판단하는 대피상황판단부, 상기 파악된 대피예상인원과 상기 대피예상지역에 관한 정보, 상기 침수 정보, 상기 대피자의 현재위치 정보 및 이동능력등급 정보를 이용하여, 대피자별 구조작업의 우선순위를 결정하는 구조의사결정부를 포함한다.

title_en: Real time sensing and monitoring system
title_ko: 실시간 화재 감지 및 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time fire detection and monitoring system. The purpose of the present invention is to photograph an initial situation of a fire through a camera in case of fire, provide the image to a fire control center and a designated resident, protect the camera from the fire, and continuously provide a fire evacuation progress image, thereby reducing human and material damage through rapid fire evacuation. According to the present invention, the real-time fire detection and monitoring system comprises: a housing (80) provided on a ceiling inside a building; a fire sensor (10) provided in the housing and detecting a fire inside the building; a camera (30) provided in the housing and photographing a fire occurrence area when the fire is detected by the fire sensor; a temperature sensor (20) provided in the housing and detecting heat around the fire sensor; a lifting unit (70) lifting the camera; a communication unit (40) providing fire detection signals by the fire sensor, temperature values sensed by the temperature sensor, and image signals photographed by the camera as fire status monitoring information to a remote fire control center and a designated resident terminal; and a controller (50) controlling the lifting unit based on the temperature value sensed by the temperature sensor in a state in which the fire is detected through the fire signal by the fire sensor, so as to move the camera from the outside to the inside of the housing such that the camera is protected from the fire and captures images.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실시간 화재 감지 및 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 화재 발생 시 카메라를 통해 화재 발생 초기 상황을 촬영하여 소방 관제 센터 및 지정된 거주자가 제공하고 카메라를 화재로부터 보호하여 화재 진행 영상을 지속적으로 제공함으로써 신속한 화재 진화를 통해 인적 및 물적 피해를 줄이는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 발명에 의한 실시간 화재 감지 및 모니터링 시스템은, 건물 내부의 천정에 설치되는 하우징(80)과; 상기 하우징에 설치되며 상기 건물 내부의 화재를 감지하는 화재 센서(10)와; 상기 하우징에 설치되며 상기 화재 센서에 의한 화재 감지 시 화재 발생 지역을 촬영하는 카메라(30)와; 상기 하우징에 설치되며 상기 화재 센서 주변의 열을 감지하는 온도 센서(20)와; 상기 카메라를 승강시키는 승강부(70)와; 상기 화재 센서에 의한 화재 감지 신호와 온도 센서에 의해 감지되는 온도 값과 상기 카메라에 의해 촬영되는 영상 신호를 원거리의 소방 관제 센터와 지정된 거주자의 단말기에 화재 상황의 모니터링 정보로 제공하는 통신부(40)와; 상기 화재 센서에 의한 화재 발생 신호를 통해 화재를 판단한 상태에서 상기 온도 센서에 의해 감지되는 온도 값을 근거로 하여 상기 승강부를 제어함으로써 상기 카메라를 상기 하우징의 외부에서 내부로 이동시켜 화재로부터 보호하여 촬영이 가능하도록 하는 컨트롤러(50)를 포함한다.

abstract_en: During an emergency evacuation of a large building it can be difficult to confirm that all areas of the building have been checked for occupants. The present invention provides an evacuation status indication device that can be installed adjacent to doors or entranceways, and which has a closed configuration in which it is not particularly noticeable, and an open or deployed configuration in which an indicator flag is exposed and is highly visible. In a preferred form, the evacuation status indication device includes a base member that can be fixed to a wall, and an activatable member that can be moved to expose or release the flag. The flag is ideally has a concertinaed fan shape with one edge of the fan attached to the base and the opposite edge attached to the activatable member.

To provide a disaster prevention business continuation system which can achieve a disaster prevention plan that protects employees and can continue a business even in emergency such as disaster in consideration of various matters including their evacuation life after the disaster.SOLUTION: In a disaster prevention business continuation system 1, a central server accessible via Internet from a portable information terminal possessed by an employee and an information terminal device of a business office where the employee works includes at least eight functions including a disaster prevention consultation function 101, a business continuation plan creation function 102, a safety confirmation evacuation guidance function 103, an evacuation training alarm function 104, a bulletin board function 105 for matching support providing business places with support receiving business places, a stockpile automatic retrieve function 106, a bulletin board function 107 for solving problem among employees, and a business continuation plan browsing function 108, and can provide various disaster prevention-related information to the employees and the business places.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

To allow a prompt and certain safety confirmation operation using entrance and exit information which is managed by an entrance and exit management system even when a function of the entrance and exit management system is stopped due to power interruption, etc. by a disaster.SOLUTION: An entrance and exit management system generates and manages entrance and exit information by a center device 10 based on user identification information of an IC card read by a card reader 18 for entrance and exit, etc. A plurality of safety confirmation terminals 24 are connected with the center device 10, and the entrance and exit information of the center device 10 is updated and recorded constantly without delay or for every predetermined period. The safety confirmation terminal 24 generates entrance and exit information obtained by adding information showing evacuation situations of persons in a building to the entrance and exit information recorded at the time in a disaster when the safety confirmation terminal 24 is taken out by disconnecting the connection with the center device 10. In addition, the safety confirmation terminal 24 collects the entrance and exit information from one or more of other safety confirmation terminals to be merged with the entrance and exit information of itself, and generates the entrance and exit information including the information showing the evacuation situations of the persons in the building to be displayed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

A computer implemented technique of tracking an evacuation of a location in an environment that utilizes physical tokens to prove physical presence at the location is presented. The technique includes receiving, by a mobile device of an evacuation facilitator, a selection from among choices including at least a real emergency and a simulated emergency; receiving wirelessly, by the mobile device, organization hierarchy data; receiving wirelessly, by the mobile device, physical token based location status information for each of a plurality of subordinates of the evacuation facilitator; displaying, by the mobile device, and based on physical token based location status information, a physical presence status at the location for each of the plurality of subordinates; receiving, by the mobile device, evacuation status information; and recording in remote persistent memory the evacuation status information, such that a second mobile device of a second evacuation facilitator displays at least the evacuation status information.

title_en: System and method for personnel identification for evacuation training
title_ko: 재난 대피용 재실 인원 확인 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a system for checking occupants for disaster evacuation includes: an entrance control server communicate-connecting with a building entrance gate, receiving tagging information of an ID card of a person entering the building entrance gate, and generating a gate entrance log; a card reader which reads the ID card of the evacuee evacuated from the building to recognize a unique identification code when a disaster occurs in a building; and a main server which compares occupancy status information generated by the unique identification code with the gate entrance log received from the entrance control server, and aggregates occupancy, evacuated personnel, and personnel who are not evacuated.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 재난 대피용 재실 인원 확인 시스템은 건물 출입 게이트(Gate)와 통신 연결되고, 상기 건물 출입 게이트를 출입하는 인원의 아이디(ID) 카드의 태깅(Tagging) 정보를 수신하여 게이트 출입 로그를 생성하는 출입 통제 서버; 건물에서 재난이 발생한 경우, 상기 건물에서 대피한 대피자의 ID 카드를 리딩(Reading)하여 고유 식별 코드를 인식하는 카드 리더기; 및 상기 고유 식별 코드에 의해 생성된 재실 현황 정보와 상기 출입 통제 서버로부터 수신된 게이트 출입 로그를 비교하여 재실 인원, 대피 인원 및 미 대피 인원을 집계하는 메인 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Information processing system, information processing device, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To make it possible to correctly determine an evacuation status of a person in a facility without having to read an IC card when moving to an evacuation site in an information processing system that determines the evacuation status of a person in the facility.SOLUTION: While an information processing system is an information processing system that determines an evacuation status of a person in a facility using a sound wave output device and a terminal device, the information processing system is comprised of: a storage unit for storing entry/exit information that manages an entry/exit of the person in the facility; a terminal information receiving unit for receiving terminal information which includes predetermined identification information and terminal identification information that identifies the terminal device, the predetermined identification information being transmitted from the terminal device which acquires the predetermined identification information corresponding to a place where the sound wave output device is installed from a sound wave output from the sound wave output device; and a determination unit for determining the evacuation status of the person who owns the terminal device based on the entry/exit information and the terminal information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

To make it easier to grasp positions of persons who have difficulty in evacuating.SOLUTION: A display system identifies whether or not there is a person having difficulty in evacuating based on a camera image obtained by photographing an area for each of a plurality of areas constituting a building. Next, the display system displays a map image which is a map image of the building and in which each of the plurality of areas is associated with information indicating whether or not there is a person having difficulty in evacuating identified for the area on a display unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

To provide a disaster safety confirmation system that can make safety confirmation information of the disaster safety confirmation system more accurate.SOLUTION: A disaster safety confirmation system 1 includes: a room entrance/exit camera 11 that takes pictures of a person passing through room entrances and exits; and an evacuation determination device 14 that determines whether or not the person who entered the room has evacuated the room by using an image of a person who was allowed to enter the room by an access control device 2 and an image of a person taken by the room entrance/exit camera 11.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
assignees: MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC BUILDING TECHNO SERVICE CO LTD

abstract_en: Disclosed is an evacuation path output system. The evacuation path output system according to the present invention is mainly installed in a large-scale building and facility. In the event of an emergency such as fire, earthquake, or terrorism, the evacuation path output system receives a control command through an automatic evacuation path guidance system that is separately implemented and adapts a method of guiding (instructing) the entire evacuation path organically and integrally according to the control command. The evacuation path output system has a simple configuration of hardware and software, thereby being easily maintained, repaired, and managed and enables even those who are not familiar with the geography to quickly get out of a dangerous area according to the instructions given thereby. Furthermore, in the present invention, each installation point detects the number and movement of evacuees and transmits the number and movement of evacuees to an integrated fire and disaster prevention system in real-time so as to make a contribution, such that a fire and disaster prevention command department can grasp an evacuation status in real-time and establish and execute emergency rescue plans based on the evacuation status.
abstract_ko:
피난경로 출력시스템이 개시된다. 
본 발명에 따른 피난경로 출력시스템은, 주로, 대규모 건축물 및 시설물에 설치되는 것으로서, 화재·지진·테러와 같은 긴급상황 발생 시, 별도로 구현되는 피난경로자동안내시스템을 통해 제어명령을 수신하고, 그 제어명령에 따라 피난 경로 전체를 유기적·통합적으로 안내(지시)하는 방식을 취하는 바, 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어의 구성이 간단하므로 유지 관리 및 보수가 용이한 이점이 있으며, 해당 지리에 익숙치 아니한 사람일지라도 그 지시하는 바에 따라 신속히 위험지역을 벗어날 수 있도록 작용한다. 
나아가, 본 발명은, 각 설치 지점에서 대피자의 수 및 동선을 감지하여 소방방재통합시스템에 실시간 송출함에 따라, 소방방재지휘부로 하여금, 대피 현황을 실시간 파악할 수 있게 하고, 이를 토대로 긴급구난계획을 수립 내지 실행하는데 기여할 수 있는 작용효과를 발휘한다.
assignees: BANG SE JUNG;JANG YOUNG JIN;PARK WON JU

title_en: Server device, system, server device control method, and storage medium
abstract_en: Provided is a server device that enables a municipality, etc., to examine the establishment of an appropriate evacuation shelter. The server device comprises a management unit, a generation unit, and a proposal unit. The management unit at least manages the number of evacuees evacuated to an evacuation shelter. On the basis of the number of evacuees evacuated to the evacuation shelter, the generation unit generates evacuation status management information, which is information for managing the evacuation status of local residents. On the basis of the generated evacuation status management information, the proposal unit generates evacuation shelter establishment proposal information pertaining to a proposal for the establishment of a new evacuation shelter and presents the generated evacuation shelter establishment proposal information to a person in charge of disaster prevention.

A smoke control facility smart control system is disclosed. The system comprises a damper control system that controls the opening and closing of smoke dampers installed in annexes on each floor of a building in the event of a fire. The damper control system includes: a non-fire floor management part which identifies the evacuation status of all non-fire floors except for the fire floor and manages the all non-fire floors by dividing the all non-fire floors into evacuation completed floors and non-evacuated floors; and a damper control part which controls the opening of the smoke damper of the fire floor and the smoke damper of the non-evacuated floor, controls the degree of opening differently so that the flow rate of the smoke damper of the non-evacuated floor is less than that of the smoke damper of the fire floor, and controls the smoke damper of the evacuation completed floor for the same to be in non-opened state.
abstract_ko: 제연설비 스마트 제어 시스템이 개시된다.  이 시스템은 화재 발생시 건물 각 층의 부속실에 설치된 방연댐퍼를 개폐 제어하는 댐퍼 제어 시스템을 포함하며, 댐퍼 제어 시스템은 화재층을 제외한 모든 비화재층의 대피 현황을 파악하여 피난 완료층과 피난 미완료층으로 구분 관리하는 비화재층 관리부, 및 화재층 방연댐퍼와 피난 미완료층 방연댐퍼를 개방 제어하되 피난 미완료층 방연댐퍼의 송출 유량이 화재층 방연댐퍼의 송출 유량보다 적게 발생하도록 개방 정도를 달리 제어하며, 피난 완료층 방연댐퍼를 미개방 제어하는 댐퍼 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Notification device, notification method, and recording medium
abstract_en: In order to notify a notification subject associated with an evacuation subject of notification information for establishing urging for the evacuation subject, this notification device comprises: an acquisition unit for acquiring position information pertaining to a first portable terminal belonging to the evacuation subject; an identification unit for identifying a contact address of the notification subject associated with the evacuation subject; an assessment unit for assessing the evacuation status of the evacuation subject in accordance with the positional relationship between a current location corresponding to the position information pertaining to the first portable terminal belonging to the evacuation subject and the position of an evacuation site allocated to the evacuation subject, and generating notification information for the notification subject in accordance with the evacuation status of the evacuation subject; and an output unit for outputting the notification information to the contact address of the notification subject.

title_en: Safety confirmation system and the like
abstract_en: To provide a system, a user terminal, and a user terminal program that can easily confirm safety.SOLUTION: A safety confirmation system 1 includes a transmitting device 2 that transmits a specific signal to a preset evacuation range 10, a user terminal 3 including transmitting means that transmits specific information identifying a user 11 who is be evacuated on the basis of the reception of the signal, and a server 4 equipped with confirmation means that confirms the evacuation status of the user 11 on the basis of the specific information. The transmitting device 2 transmits a signal by acquiring evacuation information on the basis of the occurrence of a circumstance that requires to be evacuated, including the occurrence of a disaster.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

To provide an emergency broadcasting system which can promptly and reliably implement evacuation guidance and safety confirmation to people inside and outside a building and around a facility even in a situation in which an existing broadcasting facility cannot be used due to destruction of the building, damage, submergence, fire or blackout of the broadcasting facility in the case of occurrence of a disaster such as an earthquake or flood damage.SOLUTION: An emergency broadcasting system according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an emergency signal detection unit which detects an emergency signal received by a radio; a control unit which compares a preliminarily registered emergency signal with the received emergency signal; an output switching unit which switches voice output destinations depending on a result obtained by comparing the emergency signals; and an amplification unit which amplifies voice to output communication at loud volume from a loudspeaker, built in a radio which is driven by a rechargeable battery, or in an external circuit which is connected with the radio.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Elevator evacuation support device and elevator evacuation support method
abstract_en: To provide an elevator evacuation support device and elevator evacuation support method which can achieve rapid evacuation support for a user of an elevator in the event of a disaster.SOLUTION: An elevator evacuation support device comprises a congestion status detection sensor, a passenger number detection sensor, a walking auxiliary tool detection sensor, a congestion status determination processing unit which determines the degree of congestion from the congestion status, and a route determination processing unit which creates a second evacuation route different from an evacuation route according to the degree of congestion, the route determination processing unit comprises a status prediction processing unit which predicts the congestion status after a certain period of time on the basis of the degree of congestion and an evacuation time prediction processing unit which predicts the evacuation status of an elevator user after the certain period of time on the basis of the predicted congestion status after the certain period of time, information of the elevator user detected by the walking auxiliary tool detection sensor, and information about the number of the elevator users, and when it is determined that the evacuation route cannot be used, the second evacuation route is output to a signage device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

To provide users in a disaster region with efficient and prompt safety confirmation and information collection, and evacuation alarm and evacuation instruction through telephone communications.SOLUTION: A system performs, for users in a disaster region, simultaneous communications to a plurality of phone numbers using prediction dialing, and makes connection to an operator (AI) only when a telephone is connected.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

To provide a disaster prevention application for supporting an appropriate response when a disaster occurs and contributing to reduction in disaster risk and protection of life.SOLUTION: In a disaster prevention application, a system includes: analysis means of furniture arrangement and aseismatic measures; means for reading a disaster risk map and evacuation map information; real-time evacuation instruction means; and means for sharing safety information and an evacuation status.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

An object of a system according to an embodiment is to quickly and accurately provide necessary information at the time of a disaster and support an appropriate evacuation action.SOLUTION: A system includes an information providing part, an evacuation route providing part, a safety confirmation part, and a mind care part. The information providing unit provides necessary information in case of disasters by using the generated AI. The evacuation route providing unit provides an optimal evacuation route based on the information provided by the information providing unit. The safety confirmation unit performs safety confirmation based on the evacuation route provided by the evacuation route providing unit. The mental care unit performs mental care based on the safety information confirmed by the safety confirmation unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for collecting video data in real time from a plurality of cameras installed in an educational institution; means for preprocessing the video data to prepare for analysis; means for analyzing the preprocessed video data to evaluate the behavior, facial expression, voice, and positional relationship of students; means for detecting abnormal behavior or abnormal voice and transmitting an alert to a related teacher; means for sensing a sudden disaster and transmitting an evacuation instruction; means for monitoring an evacuation situation in real time and performing safety confirmation; and means for notifying a guardian and related institutions of information on completion of evacuation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
